reason: My staff already bill on the app we use and it works fine; my own logo on the app and the live chair view are nice, but not enough reason to retrain 8 stylists and move everything. The price is not the problem, ₹500 a month is less than what I pay now.
objection: This is one person setting up five salons. If he gets busy or shuts down in a year, I have switched my whole salon for nothing and have to move back again.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a few weeks in another busy salon nearby, and hearing from that owner that support really answers in festival weeks.
